scenarios.name: normal_mixing
scenarios.description: Reference vector: MAT 18 °C sits inside the 5–22 °C envelope

scenarios.name: mat_below_both
scenarios.description: Reference vector: MAT 1 °C is 4 °C below min(oat, rat); alarms after alarm_delay (900 s)

scenarios.name: mat_above_both
scenarios.description: Reference vector: MAT 26 °C is 4 °C above max(oat, rat); alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: within_tolerance
scenarios.description: Reference vector: MAT 19 °C is 1 °C below min(oat, rat) — inside sensor_tolerance

scenarios.name: edge_gap_equals_tolerance
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: min − mat = 2.0 °C exactly; the comparison is strict, so no fault

scenarios.name: edge_gap_just_over_tolerance
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: min − mat = 2.1 °C clears the strict comparison and alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: summer_oat_above_rat
scenarios.description: Cooling season, OAT above RAT: MAT 35 °C exceeds max(oat, rat) by 3 °C

scenarios.name: full_outdoor_air_pins_to_bound
scenarios.description: Economizer at 100% OA: MAT tracks OAT and lands 0.5 °C below it — tolerance absorbs it

scenarios.name: transient_excursion_never_alarms
scenarios.description: MAT dips out of range for 600 s (< alarm_delay) and recovers; persistence timer resets

scenarios.name: fault_clears_on_recovery
scenarios.description: Sustained excursion alarms at 900 s; the alarm drops on the tick MAT returns inside the envelope
